name: Statistical Methods in Water Resources
description: Introduction to statistical concepts and probability, random variables; expectation, moments, joint and conditional distributions; probability distributions; parameter estimation; properties of estimators, efficiency, and consistency; sampling variability, confidence intervals, and goodness-of-fit tests; graphical analysis of univariate and multivariate hydrologic datasets; extreme value theory and order statistics; return period and risk analysis in hydrologic design; flood and low flow frequency analysis using annual maximum, partial duration, and threshold exceedance series; regional flood frequency analysis; stationarity and non-stationarity statistical models; correlation analysis; simple linear regression; multiple linear regression; trend analysis; change point detection of hydrological variables.
